SEARCH

All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Client
Runnable demo/smoke-test client: indexes a handful of sample documents, then runs a few different Lucene classic query shapes (term, exact keyword match, phrase, fuzzy, boolean) against them and prints the results.
ClusterTopology
The cluster's static routing table: how many shards an index is split into, how many replica copies each shard gets, and which NodeAddresses make up the cluster.
Coordinator
Process entry point for the coordinator: the single, cluster-aware front door clients talk to.
CoordinatorGrpcServer
Lifecycle wrapper around the underlying grpc-java Server for the CoordinatorServiceImpl — the coordinator process entry point (Coordinator.main) builds one and calls CoordinatorGrpcServer.start() then CoordinatorGrpcServer.awaitTermination().
CoordinatorServiceImpl
Speaks the exact same DataNodeService gRPC contract as a real data node (DataNodeServiceImpl) but never touches Lucene — it's a pure router.
DataNodeClient
Blocking gRPC client wrapper for talking to one DataNodeService — either a real data node or the coordinator, which speaks the identical contract (see CoordinatorServiceImpl).
DataNodeServiceImpl
The gRPC DataNodeService implementation that runs on every data node (Server hosts one).
DocumentConverter
Translates between the gRPC wire type (com.example.inelasticsearch.rpc.Document, a flat list of typed Fields) and a Lucene Document.
GrpcServer
Lifecycle wrapper around the underlying grpc-java Server for one DataNodeServiceImpl — the process entry point (Server.main) just builds one of these and calls GrpcServer.start() then GrpcServer.awaitTermination().
IndexService
Thin wrapper around a single Lucene IndexWriter for one shard's on-disk index.
NodeAddress
One entry in cluster.conf: a node's config id (e.g.
SearchService
Thin wrapper around a single Lucene IndexSearcher for one shard's on-disk index, taken as a point-in-time snapshot at construction — it does not see writes made after it was opened.
Server
Process entry point for one data node.
ShardCopySelector
Picks which copy of a shard to query next, round-robin across its primary and replicas so read traffic spreads across all live copies instead of always hitting the primary.
ShardRouter
The per-node, per-index storage layer: owns one Lucene IndexService/SearchService pair per shard this node stores (as primary or replica — this class doesn't distinguish between the two, it just knows which shard ids it has local indices for).
